title: Prime Number Sieve (Eratosthenes Walks)
style: ancient-modern fusion, harpsichord arpeggios, modular synth, deep sub bass, choir-like male lead vocal, female harmony, dry drums, 100 BPM, zynthio math foundations, mystical-precise
lyrics:
[Intro — ancient strings, modular arpeggio]
(spoken) Eratosthenes walks the sieve.

[Verse 1]
Two three five seven, the primes begin
Eleven thirteen seventeen, the rhythm within
Cross out the multiples, mark them down
Every prime survives the round

[Pre-Chorus]
No divisor but one and itself
The atom of arithmetic on the shelf

[Chorus]
PRIME NUMBER SIEVE — ERATOSTHENES WALKS
PRIME NUMBER SIEVE — THE INFINITE TALKS
PRIME NUMBER SIEVE — EUCLID PROVED THEM ENDLESS
PRIME NUMBER SIEVE — THE PATTERN FRIENDLESS

[Verse 2]
Nineteen twenty-three, twenty-nine thirty-one
Thirty-seven forty-one, the chase still run
Goldbach's conjecture, twin primes too
The Riemann hypothesis still searching for true

[Bridge — spoken]
Every composite number factors uniquely.
Fundamental theorem of arithmetic.
The primes are the bones, the rest is meat.
The count is infinite — the proof is complete.

[Final Chorus]
PRIME NUMBER SIEVE — THE BONES OF THE COUNT
PRIME NUMBER SIEVE — RSA SITS ATOP THE MOUNT
PRIME NUMBER SIEVE — ZYNTHIO MATH HOLDS THE SCROLL
PRIME NUMBER SIEVE — THE LINE THE PRIMES CONSOLE
